## Featured Data Analytics & ML Projects
1. **Predicting Student Dropout Risk**: End-to-end XGBoost machine learning retention pipeline across 28,785 student records. Achieved 86.88% accuracy, 86.95% recall, and 0.9434 ROC-AUC with Power BI dashboard and TreeSHAP explainability.
2. **NIKE Sales Price Prediction**: Hedonic pricing model and multi-variable regression estimating price elasticity and marketplace SKU valuation with an R² of 0.892.
3. **Online Shopper Intent Analysis**: Real-time session analytics pipeline built on Databricks with feature engineering and predictive purchase intent classification.
4. **HazeMY Air Quality Platform**: Interactive Malaysia particulate matter and air quality surveillance network integrating government API streams.
5. **KFC Qlik Sense Sales Intelligence**: Retail executive BI dashboard tracking store performance, product mix profitability, and regional sales KPIs.
